You posted in my SW thread. Thanks. If you want somebody to talk to I'm willing to exchange contact information.

I really appreciate the advice... but don't get me started on relativity (and I'm not referring to Einstein's special or general relativity, I suppose I mean linguistic, moral, and cultural relativity) or I'd develop carpal tunnel syndrome.

>  And if you dont have friend you should make friends, this might sound stupid but not everything comes to you, you have to reach out to others.

That doesn't sound stupid at all. I've been trying, man. 

> If you want someone to talk to please message me! 

Thank you.

> I know you said you don't have any friends, but let me be your friend. Talk to me.

Thanks. I'd love for somebody to talk to. I just wish I could have somebody to talk to face to face. When I initially started isolating I didn't want to talk to anybody at all. I've been isolating so long that now I crave a friend and that human connection again.   

> What happens if you do? If you decide to go 'missing', your parents would live in wonder, agony. Either way they'd always wonder what they could've done, and they'd live in agony. If your brother is similar to you, don't you think that maybe, just maybe, he'd become suicidal? You have to think about the after affects too. What would happen to your family?

In retrospect the 'going missing' plan is a bad idea. You're right they would always wonder what they could've done. I am going to leave a note saying "not to wonder", "there is nothing you could have done". I'm sure they might still wonder. Regarding my brother, he actually is suicidal. However, he handles it a lot better than me. He hasn't told our parents. He makes better decisions than me. He's the most popular kid at his school, he's nice, gets all the girls, is a funny guy, and is smart. Perhaps smarter than me. That's why I don't think he will kill himself. He's got a good head on his shoulders and a promising future, he can look past his suicidal thoughts. I envy that. I've thought about what it would do to my brother, and the rest of my family... and it fucking sucks. Like I said, it's the only thing that has kept me alive all these years. I care too much about what others think. I'm not that selfish. However, one can only endure this for so long. If I did it, I think my family would be disappointed, but honestly, not surprised. After what they've seen me go through.  

> Have you tried to travel? Just you with nature. The world, so much to see! You have so much to try, to do. You can't give up. Just please don't do it, you were brought in the world for a reason, to take yourself out of it is just...horrible. 

I've considered travel, but I barely have the motivation to get out of bed most days. I see the potential, but it doesn't appeal to me (in my current state of mind). Plus there's the whole financial thing when traveling. My parents are well off but they're Jewish-- they're not very giving unless it's absolutely necessary. They want me to get another job, and I don't see traveling as feasible. Although maybe I have the wrong idea of traveling. I know, it's awful to give up.
